text:
4. 7. 1

Saṃyojanasuttaṃ

1745. Sāvatthiyaṃ:

Pañcimāni bhikkhave, indriyāni bhāvitāni bahulīkanāni saṃyojanappahānāya saṃvattanti. Katamāni pañca: saddhindriyaṃ viriyindriyaṃ satindriyaṃ samādhindriyaṃ paññindriyaṃ. Imāni kho bhikkhave, pañcindriyāni bhāvitāni bahulīkatāni saṃyojanappahānāya saṃvattantīti.
